recap.text: Carl opens his platinum quest box after his first savage box spat out a pair of fuzzy handcuffs. Inside is a tome in black leather with a skull on the cover, warm to the touch, and he grins at the ceiling at being on the same wavelength for once. The tome glows when opened and adds Ping to his list for five mana. Ping finds no mobs or crawlers, but it finds NPCs, elites and hunters.

beats.headline: On the same wavelength
beats.text: Everyone else has opened their platinum quest boxes, mostly spell books. After his first savage box spits out a pair of fuzzy handcuffs, Carl opens his. It holds a magical tome. He turns it over in his hands: a black leather hardback, warm to the touch, with a skull on the cover. He looks up at the ceiling and grins. It's nice to see they're on the same wavelength for once. Opening the book makes it glow, and the spell adds itself to his list: Ping, five mana. It won't find mobs or crawlers, which is disappointing, but it will find NPCs, and more importantly elites and hunters.
beats.gist: Carl's tome adds Ping, a five-mana spell that finds NPCs, elites and hunters.
